note: Claims about why a chain cannot be swept. Each entry is a dated observation, not a rule. A cohort failure is only attributed to a blocker when the cohort's own log matches that blocker's logSignature; an entry with a null logSignature can never absorb a failure, so the failure is reported as unrecognised and reaches the reader.

blockers.claim: Diffyscan's explorer fetcher reads JSON keys the zkSync Era explorer API does not return, so no source can be pulled for this network.
explorer.swellnetwork.io exposes no API Diffyscan can read verified sources from.
Zircuit has no explorer API Diffyscan can read verified sources from; the network has no diffyscan/networks.json entry, so it falls through to the Etherscan default.
